description: The JSE-HPS is a 20-item Likert-scale self-report assessment developed by the Jefferson Scale of Empathy authors for measuring cognitive empathy among healthcare professions students.
title: Jefferson Scale of Empathy, Healthcare Professions Student version (JSE-HPS)

description: A 20-item, 7-point Likert self-report instrument for measuring medical students' empathic orientation toward patients, developed by the Jefferson medical education research group.
title: Jefferson Scale of Empathy – Student Version (JSPE-S)

description: A nursing-education framework developed by Jeffries and the National League for Nursing for designing, implementing, and evaluating simulation-based learning experiences.
title: Jeffries/National League for Nursing Framework for Designing, Implementing and Evaluating Simulations

description: A nature-exploration biology learning approach developed and disseminated by the Biology Department of FMIPA UNNES in Indonesia, using learners' direct experience of the natural environment.
title: Jelajah Alam Sekitar (JAS) learning approach

description: JEU SERAI is a serious game developed by a consortium of two companies, two universities, and an adult training association that uses mini-games and questionnaires to generate players' Holland RIASEC vocational-interest profiles.
title: JEU SERAI vocational guidance profiling game
